children: Market Technology Acquisition Corp will allow holders to separate and separately trade Class A ordinary shares and warrants starting Sept. 17, 2026.
Units can be separated beginning Sept. 17, 2026 so Class A shares and warrants may trade separately.
Separated Class A ordinary shares expected to trade under symbol MTAK on Nasdaq Global Market.
Separated warrants expected to trade under symbol MTAKW; only whole warrants will trade, no fractional warrants.
Units not separated will continue trading under existing symbol MTAKU on Nasdaq Global Market.
Holders must have brokers contact Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company to effect separation.
